name: M3_PPS170MI_Select
description: List planned purchase orders for a specific warehouse or warehouse group within a selected status interval. The operation returns one row per planned purchase order, including key identifiers (company, facility, warehouse, item, order proposal number and subnumbers), planning dates (planning date and release date), quantities and units of measure, status, supplier and responsible user, as well as links to projects, elements, attributes, simulation rounds and internal‑sales information. It is typically used to extract subsets of planned purchase orders for analysis or external planning, with optional filtering on material‑plan behavior and APS policy.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which planned purchase orders are listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to limit the search for planned purchase orders.

inputParameters.name: WHGR
inputParameters.description: Warehouse group used to include planned purchase orders from multiple warehouses.

inputParameters.name: STSF
inputParameters.description: Lowest planned order status to include when listing planned purchase orders.

inputParameters.name: STST
inputParameters.description: Highest planned order status to include when listing planned purchase orders.

inputParameters.name: P150
inputParameters.description: Setting controlling whether the planned purchase orders update the item's material plan and balance.

inputParameters.name: APIP
inputParameters.description: APS policy used to filter planned purchase orders created by advanced planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the warehouse and planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse for which the planned purchase order is created.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PRCS
outputParameters.description: Service process linked to the planned purchase order for subcontract or repair purchases.

outputParameters.name: SUFI
outputParameters.description: Service ID tied to the subcontract or repair operation on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Internal number identifying the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPS
outputParameters.description: Subnumber identifying a line or part of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLP2
outputParameters.description: Secondary subnumber for further identification of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when the planned purchase order affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: PPQT
outputParameters.description: Planned purchase quantity for the item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PSTS
outputParameters.description: Status code of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the planned purchase order, such as a customer or manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Order category of the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PPSQ
outputParameters.description: Co-sorting identity used to separate or combine planned orders when creating inquiries or purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User ID responsible for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: STRT
outputParameters.description: Product structure type associated with the item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PROJ
outputParameters.description: Project number to which the planned purchase order is linked.

outputParameters.name: ELNO
outputParameters.description: Project element within the project that the planned purchase order is linked to.

outputParameters.name: ECVS
outputParameters.description: Simulation round identifier for the configuration related to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number used for configured items on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: MACN
outputParameters.description: Macro order number grouping related planned purchase orders.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity in the item's basic unit of measure for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: UNMS
outputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure in which inventory for the item is managed.

outputParameters.name: ICTR
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the planned purchase order is for an internal sale.

outputParameters.name: FWHL
outputParameters.description: Supplying warehouse from which goods are sourced for internal sales.

outputParameters.name: RELD
outputParameters.description: Planned release date when the planned purchase order should be converted into an actual purchase order.
